title: 第五章 回大湾村第六章 两村赌斗
content_zh:
对方秒接，在电话那头嚎一嗓子：“卧槽，东子，你还活着，你在哪儿？终于舍得跟哥联系了？”
听到顾文的大嗓门，一下子让殷东找回熟悉的感觉。
在前世，这个高中三年的同桌始终是他不离不弃的铁哥们，帮过他很多，只是顾家倒大霉的日子也不远了。
重生回来，他或许能做一些改变吧。
“我在白山镇，有个事要你找人帮忙。”
殷东直截了当的说。
“白山镇是吧？”
电话那头有些吵，顾文大声的吼着，“行！
我明天一早就过来，有话当面说，你把下酒菜准备好，我把我家老头子的好酒顺两瓶来。”
“你没上学？”
殷东吃惊的问。
要是他没记错，顾文应该己经在省城上大二了吧。
“没有你一起打架闹事，上学没劲儿，我刚请了病假，今天才到县里。”
顾文笑道。
“滚粗，劳资从来不打架闹事。”
殷东笑骂着，挂了电话，让王海生去办了出院手续，坐他那辆送货的小面包回了大湾村。
镇上到大湾村的路不好走，回村的时候，天己经擦黑，村里人都在吃晚饭，有不少孩子端着饭碗围过来，又被家里人喊回去了，殷东忽然感觉到一种无形的排斥，下意识的朝王海生看了一眼。
王海生苦笑了一下，说道：“村里人都是些老思想，被你奶和你二婶的那些话给吓着了。
反正小宝还小，感受不到这些，过段时间，流言自然就散了。”
也就是说他儿子，现在被村里人当成了灾星？

殷东只觉得一股血头直冲脑门顶，要是二婶在跟前，他保准能打死她。
前一世，他并没有察觉到这个问题，是因为他儿子最终并没有找回来，回村的时候，村里人还纷纷来安慰他，所以他内心里对这个渔村还有一种乡土之情。
现在他的心里中浇了一桶凉水似的，透心的凉。
殷东面无表情的打开了门，满身金毛的看家狗大金就扑了过来。
小宝睡着了，大金在他额头上轻舔了一下时，小家伙在梦中咯咯的笑了。
大金低低的“呜呜”
的叫了两声，像是怕吵醒了小宝似的，闭上了嘴巴，悄无声息的蹿了出去，看王海生正在把门外的东西往屋里搬，它也叼起一个塑料袋，飞快的冲进去了。
王海生就笑道：“东子，你家这狗简直不要太聪明了。
你二婶走的时候，还怂恿你奶奶到你家看一看，大金硬是堵着门没让她们进，比我们家的虎子聪明太多了。”
殷东把小宝放到床上之后出来，看向大金，眼神变暖，笑道：“那是，狗都是随主人的，虎子笨，也是有原因的。”
“滚你的！”
王海生笑骂了一声，又开玩笑的问：“你要不要也坐个月子，哥哥来侍候你坐月子，给你煮几个糖水鸡蛋吃？”
“算了吧，你别给我把厨房烧了，赶紧滚，你妈喊你回家吃饭了。”
殷东笑着捶了好兄弟一拳，心底的郁闷消散了一些，人生有三五知己，足矣！
“你……”
王海生才刚说了一个字，就听到他妈的粗嗓门在大门外喊起来。
他怕吵醒了殷小宝，只得匆匆跑了出去，在门外低声冲他妈不满的说：“你喊什么？是不是想我跟姐一样去镇里不回来了，你就高兴了？”
content_en:
The other party answered the call instantly and howled on the other end of the phone: "Damn it, Dongzi, you're still alive, where are you? Are you finally willing to contact me?"
Hearing Gu Wen's loud voice, Yin Dong suddenly regained a familiar feeling.
In his previous life, this high school classmate for three years had always been his best friend and had helped him a lot, but the day when the Gu family would be in bad luck was not far away.
After being reborn, he might be able to make some changes.
"I'm in Baishan Town. I need you to find someone to help me with something."
Yin Dong said straightforwardly.
"Baishan Town, right?"
There was some noise on the other end of the phone, and Gu Wen shouted loudly, "Okay!
I'll come over early tomorrow morning and talk to you face to face. You prepare the food and drinks, and I'll bring you two bottles of my old man's good wine. "
"You didn't go to school?"
Yin Dong asked in surprise.
If he remembered correctly, Gu Wen should already be in his sophomore year in the provincial capital.
"Without you fighting and making trouble together, school is boring. I just called in sick and just arrived in the county today."
Gu Wen smiled.
"Get out of here, labor and management never fight or cause trouble."
Yin Dong smiled and cursed, hung up the phone, asked Wang Haisheng to go through the discharge procedures, and took his delivery van back to Dawan Village.
The road from the town to Dawan Village was difficult. When we returned to the village, it was already dark. Everyone in the village was having dinner. Many children came around with their rice bowls. They were called back by their families. Yin Dong suddenly felt an invisible rejection and subconsciously glanced at Wang Haisheng.
Wang Haisheng smiled bitterly and said: "The people in the village are all old-fashioned and were frightened by what your grandma and your second aunt said.
Anyway, Xiaobao is still young and cannot feel these things. After a while, the rumors will naturally dissipate. "
In other words, his son is now regarded as a disaster by the villagers?
Yin Dong felt a rush of blood rushing to the top of his forehead. If his second aunt was here, he would definitely beat her to death.
In the previous life, he was not aware of this problem because his son was not found in the end. When he returned to the village, the villagers came to comfort him one after another, so he still had a sense of country feelings for this fishing village in his heart.
Now it was as if a bucket of cold water had been poured into his heart, which made him feel cold to the core.
Yin Dong opened the door expressionlessly, and the golden-haired guard dog Dajin rushed over.
Xiaobao fell asleep, and when Dajin lightly licked his forehead, the little guy giggled in his sleep.
Dajin's low "Woo"
He screamed twice, as if he was afraid of waking up Xiaobao, closed his mouth, and jumped out quietly. Seeing that Wang Haisheng was moving things outside the door into the house, he also picked up a plastic bag and rushed in quickly.
Wang Haisheng smiled and said: "Dongzi, this dog of yours is simply not too smart.
When your second aunt left, she even encouraged your grandma to come to your house to take a look. Dajin just blocked the door and didn't let them in. She was much smarter than our Huzi. "
Yin Dong came out after putting Xiaobao on the bed, looked at Dajin, his eyes warmed, and said with a smile: "That's right, dogs follow their masters, and tigers are stupid for a reason."
"Get out of here!"
Wang Haisheng laughed and scolded, and then asked jokingly: "Would you like to do confinement period too, and my brother will come to wait for you during confinement period and cook some sugar-watered eggs for you?"
"Forget it, don't burn the kitchen down for me, get out now, your mother told you to go home for dinner."
Yin Dong smiled and punched his good brother, and the depression in his heart dissipated a little. It is enough to have three or five close friends in life!
"You..."
Just as Wang Haisheng said a word, he heard a fucking rough voice shouting outside the gate.
He was afraid of waking up Yin Xiaobao, so he had to run out in a hurry, and whispered dissatisfiedly to his mother outside the door: "What are you shouting for? Do you think you will be happy if I go to town like my sister and never come back?"
